game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the hold guard must hold off frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Then check refactor_score and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from frozen golems in Sled Run: keep refactor_score above zero until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 6, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Snowy Hold
